nodes.name: SolutionHeroStage.tsx
nodes.summary: Client-side stage for the solution hero: renders the project's live site inside a drawn browser-window frame with three size states (inset/hero/full-screen), an interaction shield to hand pointer control to the embedded iframe, and Fullscreen API integration.

nodes.name: SolutionMedia.tsx
nodes.summary: Media gallery and demo-request CTA section for a solution's sub-landing page, showing screenshots via MediaSlot with a "provisional" notice while every slot is still a placeholder.

nodes.name: SolutionRelated.tsx
nodes.summary: "Other solutions in the ecosystem" cross-links section shown at the bottom of a solution page, excluding the current solution.

nodes.name: SolutionSteps.tsx
nodes.summary: Numbered step-by-step "how it works" grid for a solution's sub-landing page.

nodes.name: SolutionStory.tsx
nodes.summary: Solution detail/story section pairing descriptive paragraphs with a sidebar of animated stat counters.

nodes.name: SolutionSubProjects.tsx
nodes.summary: Optional section listing a solution's sub-projects (e.g. Etaysir under WIFACILITY) as cards; renders nothing if the solution has none.

nodes.name: SolutionVideoReveal.tsx
nodes.summary: Scroll-driven presentation-video reveal on a solution page: a small rounded video card grows to full-bleed as the section arrives in view, with fullscreen support, a manual stretch override, and gated autoplay.
nodes.languageNotes: Growth progress is derived from the section's arrival ("top bottom" -> "bottom bottom") rather than the pinned scroll track, and card geometry is interpolated as explicit pixel width/height rather than CSS scale() to avoid distorting border radius and text.

nodes.name: JsonLd.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders one JSON-LD structured-data <script> block, escaping "<" so embedded string data can never break out of the tag.

nodes.name: EarthNetwork.tsx
nodes.summary: Default-export 3D globe scene (react-three-fiber) used by the homepage hero's "earth" visual mode: a rotating sphere with fresnel atmosphere, a fibonacci-distributed starfield backdrop, per-solution markers alternating signal/cool accent colors, and connecting arcs, with pop-in entrance animation and hover/click interaction.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses spherical-to-cartesian placement, a fibonacci sphere distribution for stars, and a hand-written fresnel shader for the atmosphere glow (no postprocessing dependency).

nodes.name: InfraStack.tsx
nodes.summary: Default-export 3D infrastructure-stack scene (react-three-fiber) used by the homepage hero's "stack" visual mode: four glass layers (Applications/Données/Calcul/Réseau) with etched patterns, status LEDs and a scan line, corner pillars carrying packets, one glowing module per solution linked between layers, and a grid floor with rising motes.
nodes.languageNotes: Retuned for a light hero ground: normal blending plus steel/signal-deep "WIRE" colors for anything drawn over the background, while additive blending is kept only for elements drawn on the dark glass layer plates.

nodes.name: fallbacks.tsx
nodes.summary: Pure-CSS stand-ins for the two hero 3D scenes: loading placeholders and WebGL/error-boundary fallbacks, kept apart from the scene files so importing a fallback never pulls three.js into the main bundle.

nodes.name: sky.tsx
nodes.summary: Shared starfield/nebula/meteor background, brand color constants, and canvas texture generators used by the 3D hero scenes.
nodes.languageNotes: sizeAttenuation={false} on every star layer is the key trick that keeps distant point-based stars visible in pixel-size terms rather than collapsing to sub-pixel under perspective attenuation.

nodes.name: SolutionHeroStage
nodes.summary: Owns the solution hero's live-preview browser-window frame: three size states (inset/hero/fullscreen), Fullscreen API wiring with a fixed-overlay fallback, pointer-handoff shield over the embedded iframe, and layered fallbacks (previewUrl -> showcaseImage -> generated mock).

nodes.name: FrameChrome
nodes.summary: Renders the drawn browser-window title bar: traffic lights, host address pill with a loading pulse, and stretch/fullscreen/open-in-new-tab controls.

nodes.name: FrameMock
nodes.summary: Generated on-brand placeholder shown inside the preview frame before any real screenshot or live preview is available.

nodes.name: SolutionMedia
nodes.summary: Renders the solution's media gallery grid plus a demo-access request CTA, with copy that flags placeholder images until real assets are set.

nodes.name: SolutionRelated
nodes.summary: Renders cross-links to the other published solutions, or nothing if there are none.

nodes.name: SolutionSteps
nodes.summary: Renders a solution's numbered how-it-works steps in a responsive grid.

nodes.name: SolutionStory
nodes.summary: Renders solution description paragraphs alongside a sidebar of animated stat counters.

nodes.name: SolutionSubProjects
nodes.summary: Renders a solution's sub-projects as cards, or nothing if the solution has none.

nodes.name: SolutionVideoReveal
nodes.summary: Drives the presentation-video reveal: computes section-arrival-based growth progress via ScrollTrigger, paints explicit pixel geometry for the growing card, gates autoplay on stretch+visibility, and manages fullscreen/manual-override state.

nodes.name: VideoMock
nodes.summary: Generated on-brand placeholder shown inside the video frame until presentationVideo is set.

nodes.name: JsonLd
nodes.summary: Serializes and escapes a data object into a JSON-LD <script type="application/ld+json"> tag.

nodes.name: sphericalToCartesian
nodes.summary: Converts spherical (phi/theta) angles plus radius into a THREE.Vector3 for placing markers on the globe surface.

nodes.name: fibonacciSphere
nodes.summary: Generates an evenly-distributed set of points on a sphere using the fibonacci/golden-angle method, used for the starfield.

nodes.name: Atmosphere
nodes.summary: Renders the globe's soft fresnel-falloff atmospheric rim light via a custom shader material.

nodes.name: GlobeBody
nodes.summary: Renders the globe's solid sphere mesh with its surface texture and grid lines.

nodes.name: ServiceMarker
nodes.summary: Renders one interactive solution marker pill on the globe: hover/click handling, signal/cool accent alternation, hover escalation to signal-bright, and the label/preview hover card.

nodes.name: ServiceArc
nodes.summary: Draws the connecting arc line between two service markers on the globe surface.

nodes.name: Scene
nodes.summary: Composes the globe scene: camera/controls, lighting, atmosphere, starfield/sky layers, and the set of service markers and arcs, with pop-in entrance timing.

nodes.name: EarthNetwork
nodes.summary: Default-exported entry component: mounts the globe inside a react-three-fiber Canvas with WebGL fallback, fade-in on context creation, and an interaction hint overlay.

nodes.name: patternTexture
nodes.summary: Generates one of the layer-specific etched canvas textures (app tiles, disk clusters, server racks, circuit traces) used on each glass layer's surface.

nodes.name: floorTexture
nodes.summary: Generates the glowing grid-floor canvas texture beneath the stack.

nodes.name: Blinkers
nodes.summary: Renders a layer's blinking status LEDs and sweeping scan line, additively blended onto the dark glass plate.

nodes.name: Layer
nodes.summary: Renders one glass infrastructure layer: its etched pattern texture, edges, blinkers, and unfold animation.

nodes.name: Pillar
nodes.summary: Renders one corner light pillar carrying packets between layers.

nodes.name: ModuleLink
nodes.summary: Renders the beam connecting a service module to the next layer.

nodes.name: Floor
nodes.summary: Renders the grid floor mesh with its glowing texture beneath the stack.

nodes.name: Uplink
nodes.summary: Renders rising motes/particles from the floor into the stack.

nodes.name: ServiceModule
nodes.summary: Renders one interactive glowing service module docked on a layer: hover/click handling, dark-glass lit-from-within look, and the label/preview hover card.

nodes.name: Scene
nodes.summary: Composes the infra-stack scene: camera/controls, lighting, the four layers, pillars, modules and links, and floor, with the pop-then-unfold entrance sequence.

nodes.name: useReducedMotion
nodes.summary: Hook reading the prefers-reduced-motion media query via useSyncExternalStore for gating the stack's entrance and idle animations.

nodes.name: InfraStack
nodes.summary: Default-exported entry component: mounts the infra-stack scene inside a react-three-fiber Canvas with WebGL fallback, fade-in on context creation, and an interaction hint overlay.

nodes.name: EarthNetworkFallback
nodes.summary: Pure-CSS static stand-in for the globe scene, used as loading/WebGL-unavailable/error-boundary fallback.

nodes.name: EarthSkyPlaceholder
nodes.summary: Minimal ambient-glow placeholder shown transiently while the globe's 3D chunk loads.

nodes.name: InfraStackFallback
nodes.summary: Pure-CSS static stand-in for the infra-stack scene, used as loading/WebGL-unavailable/error-boundary fallback.

nodes.name: InfraSkyPlaceholder
nodes.summary: Minimal ambient-glow placeholder shown transiently while the infra-stack's 3D chunk loads.

nodes.name: hash
nodes.summary: Deterministic pseudo-random float generator from an index, safe to call during render (pure, unlike Math.random).

nodes.name: radialGlowTexture
nodes.summary: Generates a radial-gradient canvas texture used for glow sprites.

nodes.name: starTexture
nodes.summary: Generates the mapped sprite texture that makes starfield points render as soft circles instead of hard squares.

nodes.name: writeStarColor
nodes.summary: Writes a per-star vertex color inside the brand palette (mostly paper, a cool minority toward aqua, a few toward signal) into a color buffer.

nodes.name: buildStarLayer
nodes.summary: Builds one star-layer's buffer geometry (positions and colors) for a given shell radius.

nodes.name: buildStarBand
nodes.summary: Builds a denser band of stars distributed within a radius range, used for depth variation.

nodes.name: StarLayer
nodes.summary: Renders one additively-blended, non-size-attenuated star shell with independent rotation.

nodes.name: StarField
nodes.summary: Renders the full multi-shell starfield backdrop (~9.6k points across several draw calls) — the core visual element that makes the background sky read as photographed rather than illustrated.

nodes.name: BrightStars
nodes.summary: Renders a handful of bright stars with halo, core, and crossed diffraction-spike sprites, kept rare and positioned clear of the logo and copy.

nodes.name: ShootingStar
nodes.summary: Renders one animated meteor streak.

nodes.name: NebulaCloud
nodes.summary: Renders one faint additively-blended gas-cloud sprite for background color temperature.

nodes.name: Meteors
nodes.summary: Renders the set of shooting-star meteors across the sky.
